title: Building a Framework-Based Application knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which item is explicitly listed under "Building a Framework-Based Application" in the source curriculum?
questions.explanation: The supplied PHP curriculum lists "Routing and controllers" under "Building a Framework-Based Application". This lesson relates that topic to a small example and a testable result.

questions.prompt: What output should you expect from the example in this lesson?
options: begin transaction -> validate changes -> commit or roll back
questions.answer_key: begin transaction -> validate changes -> commit or roll back
questions.explanation: The example is intended to produce this output: 'begin transaction -> validate changes -> commit or roll back'. Trace the relevant values and operations in order, then compare your prediction with the result.

questions.prompt: If an example related to "Building a Framework-Based Application" behaves unexpectedly, what should you do first?
options: Suppress every error so execution always continues.
Assume a runtime or dependency bug before checking inputs and versions.
Reduce the issue to a small reproducible input, inspect values and the expected result, then change one cause and retest.
Change unrelated code until the symptom disappears.
questions.answer_key: Reduce the issue to a small reproducible input, inspect values and the expected result, then change one cause and retest.
questions.explanation: A small reproducible case makes the cause easier to identify. Check the input, the PHP/runtime version, and the expected output; then change one thing and retest.

status_note: Answer keys and explanations must remain repository/backend-side and are returned only as per-question feedback after a learner submits an answer.
